package.name: vio_benchmark
package.description:
Flies a helix round a tower or a transit above the conductors, closed loop over the wrapper surface, so a visual-inertial estimator (OpenVINS) can be scored on each against Gazebo ground truth.
Publishes the flight phase, in simulation time, as JSON on ~/phase. scripts/vio_trial.sh runs OpenVINS, the recorder, this flight and scripts/vio_eval.py in one go.
